test_cases.title: Delivery details lead to the order review listing both products
test_cases.description: [Use case] A shopper with two products submits complete delivery details and reaches the review.
test_cases.automation_decision_reason: Bench Shop has no API: the behavior is visible only on the rendered checkout screens, so it is checked end to end.
preconditions: Bench Shop v1 is served at BASE_URL.

steps.action: Sign in with the demo account the sign-in screen shows.
Put the Bevel-Edge Chisel Set and the Brass Marking Gauge in the basket.
Open the basket and go to checkout.
Fill the delivery details and submit them.

expected_results: The "Review your order" screen is shown.
It lists the Bevel-Edge Chisel Set and the Brass Marking Gauge.

test_cases.title: The Items figure is the sum of the basket prices
test_cases.description: [Calculation] The review states the Items figure the shopper is about to pay for.
test_cases.automation_decision_reason: Bench Shop has no API: the behavior is visible only on the rendered checkout screens, so it is checked end to end.
preconditions: Bench Shop v1 is served at BASE_URL.

steps.action: Sign in with the demo account the sign-in screen shows.
Put the Bevel-Edge Chisel Set and the Brass Marking Gauge in the basket.
Open the basket and go to checkout.
Fill the delivery details and submit them.
Read the prices listed and the "Items" figure.

expected_results: The "Items" figure equals the exact sum of the prices listed on the review, computed from the prices shown.

test_cases.title: The Order total is Items plus Sales tax
test_cases.description: [Calculation] The three figures on the review add up.
test_cases.automation_decision_reason: Bench Shop has no API: the behavior is visible only on the rendered checkout screens, so it is checked end to end.
preconditions: Bench Shop v1 is served at BASE_URL.

steps.action: Sign in with the demo account the sign-in screen shows.
Put the Bevel-Edge Chisel Set and the Brass Marking Gauge in the basket.
Open the basket and go to checkout.
Fill the delivery details and submit them.
Read the "Items", "Sales tax" and "Order total" figures.

expected_results: The "Order total" equals the shown "Items" figure plus the shown "Sales tax", to the cent.

test_cases.title: Delivery details without a postcode are refused
test_cases.description: [Equivalence partition] Negative case: a required field is left empty.
test_cases.automation_decision_reason: Bench Shop has no API: the behavior is visible only on the rendered checkout screens, so it is checked end to end.
preconditions: Bench Shop v1 is served at BASE_URL.

steps.action: Sign in with the demo account the sign-in screen shows.
Put the Bevel-Edge Chisel Set and the Brass Marking Gauge in the basket.
Open the basket and go to checkout.
Fill the given name and family name, leave the postcode empty, and submit.

expected_results: The message "Please enter a postcode." is shown.
The "Review your order" screen is not reached.

test_cases.title: Placing the order confirms it and clears the basket count
test_cases.description: [Use case] The shopper places the reviewed order.
test_cases.automation_decision_reason: Bench Shop has no API: the behavior is visible only on the rendered checkout screens, so it is checked end to end.
preconditions: Bench Shop v1 is served at BASE_URL.

steps.action: Sign in with the demo account the sign-in screen shows.
Put the Bevel-Edge Chisel Set and the Brass Marking Gauge in the basket.
Open the basket and go to checkout.
Fill the delivery details and submit them.
Place the order.

expected_results: The "Order placed" confirmation is shown, reading "Your order is on its way to the workshop."
The basket count is no longer shown.
